editorial:
Imagine meeting the love of your life at the exact moment you realize your life is already planned out with someone else. That is the messy situation you get into with Stevie and Neil. Stevie is expecting a baby from her flashy footballer husband, while Neil is in the middle of adopting a child with his wife. When they meet during a kitchen delivery, the spark is instant and totally inconvenient. It is a lighthearted rom-com that feels like a cozy British afternoon, focusing on that awkward feeling of being in the wrong relationship while staring at the right person.

The acting is great because it feels natural and not over-the-top, making you really root for these two to figure things out. While the plot is pretty simple and predictable, the charm comes from the funny dialogue and the genuine chemistry between the leads. If you are in the mood for something sweet and low-stress, you should definitely check this one out. You can find it by renting it on Apple TV for a quick movie night, or if you love owning your films, try to find a physical copy for your collection to keep the good vibes around.
endingExplained: After a lot of lying and awkward situations, the truth finally comes out for everyone. Both Stevie and Neil realize that their current partners are not the right fit for them. They decide to stop pretending and break away from their mistaken marriages. In the end, they choose to be together, proving that love can happen at the worst time. They find a way to move forward happily as a couple, leaving the drama behind.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves classic British rom-coms and stories about fate.
